summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly report on new residential construction for August 2022 (released September 20, 2022). Relevant to the task: It provides the seasonally adjusted total units under construction (Table 4a) and seasonally adjusted annual rate for total building permits (Table 1a) for August 2022 (1,702k units; 1,517k permits) and July 2022 (1,676k units; 1,685k permits). These figures enable the calculation of the 'under construction to permits' ratio and the month-over-month increase for August 2022, covering the beginning of the specified 2022/08–2025/05 timeframe. The August data is preliminary and July data is revised, meaning these specific values are subject to potential updates or supersession by later reports in the collection per task precedence rules.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release for new residential construction statistics for September 2022 (released October 19, 2022).
